name: shared-app-registry
$tagsComment: The client of the app registry in nuxeo-agentic-core (docs/business-apps/architecture.md, section 7): which apps the person signed in may see, which one is open, and where each file of its definition is read from. Shared data access, as app-config and nuxeo-client are, so that the engines (home, queues, document-layouts) and the app can read through it.
